question_text: A Depot object has self.slots, a fixed-length Python list whose empty positions contain None. Construct method add_asset(self, asset) placing asset in the first empty position and returning its index. Return -1 if full; do not resize the list.
adaptation_rationale: Translate object-array traversal to Python list slots; fix defective first MS example. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
